user.title: Connect Haier TV
user.description: For LE40AL88G31R1 (YunOS / Android API 19) only. Disable the existing Android Debug Bridge integration for this TV first; old adbd allows one client. Authorize the new ADB key on the television when prompted.

reauth_confirm.title: Authorize Home Assistant
reauth_confirm.description: Confirm the debugging authorization dialog on the TV, then submit to reconnect.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check the address, ADB debugging and other connected clients.
error.auth_failed: Authorize Home Assistant's ADB key on the TV, then retry.
error.unsupported_device: Unsupported model, firmware, missing hardware identity, or a different TV at this address.
error.invalid_response: The TV did not return valid native settings.
error.adb_in_use: Disable the existing Android Debug Bridge integration for this TV before connecting.

init.title: Power control
init.description: Choose what to change. Each page saves independently and keeps your other settings.

menu_options.power_off: Turn off · ADB or custom action

power_on.title: Turn-on action
power_on.description: Choose your existing IR service or script. The action runs once; power-on succeeds only when the TV reconnects and its screen is on. Clear the actions to remove the power-on control.

data_description.turn_on_action: Use Add action to choose a service or script. You can use the same power toggle for turn-on and turn-off.

power_off.title: Turn-off method
power_off.description: Choose how the media player turns off the TV. Custom action opens an action editor on the next page.

data_description.turn_off_mode: ADB uses the vendor remote power-off path. Custom actions can use IR or scripts. Switching methods preserves your saved action.

power_off_action.title: Custom turn-off action
power_off_action.description: Choose your IR service or script. The action runs once; completion waits for the screen to turn off or the TV to disconnect.

data_description.turn_off_action: At least one action is required. The same IR power toggle as turn-on is supported.

power_state.title: State detection and timeout
power_state.description: These settings apply to both power-on and power-off.

data_description.offline_as_off: Keeps the power-on button available while the TV is offline. Network failures also look like power-off. Authorization or invalid-response errors still show unavailable.
data_description.power_timeout: Includes action execution and waiting for the TV. Default 120 seconds; a timeout reports an error without resending the power command.

error.invalid_action: Invalid action sequence. Check the action configuration.
